chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
"Whoever gives the adhan for seven years, seeking reward, will come on the Day of Judgment with no sin upon him."

key_terms.أَذَّنَ: gave the adhan, meaning he made the call to prayer
key_terms.سَبْعَ سِنِينَ: seven years, indicating sustained and long-term devotion
key_terms.مُحْتَسِبًا: seeking Allah’s reward with sincerity and conscious intention
key_terms.يَوْمَ الْقِيَامَةِ: the Day of Judgment, when people are resurrected and judged

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for giving the adhan sincerely for seven years?
ai.summary: This hadith praises perseverance in giving the adhan with sincere intention for Allah’s reward. It highlights the عظیم spiritual merit of this act of worship and its effect on one’s state on the Day of Judgment.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: "Whoever calls the adhan (call to prayer) for seven years with the intention of seeking Allah’s (swt) reward will come on the Day of Judgment without any sins."
